basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a recent college grad based in San Francisco. I discovered Reddit while looking for gaming buddies and quickly got hooked. I love basketball, especially college hoops, and I'm a huge fan of the USF Dons. When I'm not cheering for my team, you can find me exploring the latest indie films or dabbling in voiceover work. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work. Currently, I'm working as a freelance graphic designer, trying to save up for a trip to Japan.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have always been passionate about visual arts and storytelling. I'm self-taught in voiceover work, which I picked up from online forums and YouTube tutorials. My love for basketball comes from years of playing in school and being a dedicated fan.
